blocker.title: BLOCKER: bounded cohort admission is absent from the live Evidence mirror
evidence: src/acquisition/factory.py::_configured_mirror enables MirroringTransactionAcquisition solely when EVIDENCE_PLATFORM_ENABLED and EVIDENCE_MIRROR_ENABLED are true.
EvidenceConfig has no cohort allowlist, cohort manifest, maximum-envelope counter, or closed-cohort state.
Therefore enabling the existing mirror would observe all Creator Funding shared acquisition traffic, not the Phase 1 maximum of 50 deterministic migrated tokens.
blocker.next_e_impact: A global mirror cannot satisfy the canonical bounded-shadow, deterministic cohort, stop-boundary, per-cohort equivalence, or measured-load requirements. Activating it would be broader than authorized.
blocker.minimum_remediation: Implement and test a default-OFF, deterministic Evidence mirror cohort gate before writer supervision or feature activation. The gate must admit only an immutable manifest/allowlist, preserve fail-open behaviour, and expose explicit excluded/accepted accounting.
